name: Sail Newport Summer Youth Sailing Programs
description_short: Summer sailing lessons for ages 5–17 at Fort Adams in Newport, RI. There are two-week dinghy sessions and one-week keelboat sessions from beginner to advanced, plus a short one-week introductory program called Little Guppies for 5- and 6-year-olds.
refund_policy_summary: If your child can't attend at the payment deadline (usually March), you owe nothing. Cancel before April 12, 2026: refund minus a $30 fee. Cancel April 13, 2026 or later: refund minus a $50 fee, but only if the spot is filled. If the spot is not filled, there is no refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every child must pass a swim check at the start of each session: swim 20 yards and tread water for 2 minutes, wearing a life jacket. Life jackets must be worn at all times on the docks and in boats. Loaner life jackets are available for first-time sailors.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13, and the page only shows the 2026 season, which is over. The 2027 dates, prices and application window are not posted yet.

Keelboat Session 1 is listed as June 15–18 with 'No class on Thursday, June 19th', but June 19, 2026 was a Friday. The dinghy schedule says no class on Friday, June 19. The keelboat dates may contain a typo.
The page doesn't agree on which keelboat is used. The boat list names the J/7, but the class descriptions name the J/22.
Prices shown are the first-child rates. Siblings pay less: $750 for dinghy, $650 for keelboat. Little Guppies has no sibling discount.
Ages are based on birth year: you have to be the minimum age by January 1 of the season year.
The Little Guppies and Keelboat parent handbooks linked on the page are labeled '25', which suggests they are 2025 documents.
